method: OpenMolcas state-averaged CAS fragment and six-state subspace checks

fragment_gate.rejection_reason: The 0.302 eV gap mismatch is about twenty times the leading 20 A charge-dipole scale; CAS(3,4) has not demonstrated the correct asymptotic model.

subspace_gate.result: The two six-state preparations span the same subspace to the printed overlap precision (cross-block singular values approximately one).
subspace_gate.density_note: The installed OpenMolcas build lacks usable HDF5 output despite TRD1 input; no state-averaged density agreement is claimed.

decision: Do not run 10 or 8 A interaction points. Enlarge/correct the asymptotic active-space and dynamic-correlation model first, then repeat this gate.
